**Finding: missing (critical) — no limitation of liability anywhere in the agreement.**

What I checked:
- Full outline and every body section: Sections 1–2 (HDI/Company responsibilities), 3 (Fees; Payment), 4 (Term/Termination Payment), 5 (Site management), 6 (Exclusivity), 7 (Cross-Promotions), 8 (Confidentiality), 9 (Warranties), 10 (General Provisions).
- Targeted searches for "liability", "damages", "indemnif" and "warrant" — the only hits for liability are the no-joint-venture language in 10.2, i.e. no cap, no aggregate-liability wording, and no consequential damages exclusion (including nothing hidden in the warranty section).
- Economics for the cap base: under Section 3.1 the Company pays HDI 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month, so a "fees paid or payable by the Company" base is real, not illusory.

Redline (validated ok:true): new Section 9(c) inserted after p0058 — mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000; mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages; uncapped "Excluded Claims" for confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement; and the Company's Section 3/4.2 payment obligations expressly not treated as capped damages. Placed inside Section 9 so it survives termination under Section 10.7 (which lists Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10), avoiding renumbering of Section 10.
